g.text: PORT SIDE REMOVED | LOOKING STARBOARD (+Y) | STRUCTURAL HATCHING APPLIED
1. THIS DRAWING DEPICTS THE XV-304 'ASTRAEUS' ORBITAL TRANSPORT IN CLEAN CONFIGURATION.
2. ALL DIMENSIONS ARE NOMINAL DESIGN TARGETS IN METERS. TOLERANCES PER ASME Y14.5-2018.
3. PRIMARY STRUCTURE: AL-LI 2195 FRICTION STIR WELDED BARRELS, TI-6AL-4V FORGED RINGS.
4. TPS: AFRSI BLANKETS (LEEWARD), TUFI TILES (WINDWARD NOSE/LEADING EDGES).
5. PROPULSION: 3X XE-450 EXPANDER BLEED CYCLE ENGINES, LOX/LH2, GIMBALED ±12°.
6. AVIONICS: TRIPLE-REDUNDANT FLIGHT COMPUTERS (RAD-HARD), FIBER OPTIC DATABUS.
7. ECLSS: CLOSED-LOOP O2/CO2, WATER RECOVERY 98%. RADIATORS: 2X DEPLOYABLE 15m².
8. LANDING GEAR: TRI-CYCLE, RETRACTABLE. NOSE: SINGLE WHEEL. MAIN: DUAL TANDEM (X2).
9. SOLAR ARRAYS: 2X 15m ULTRAFLEX BLANKETS, 28% EFF. GAAS, 25kW BOL.
11. DOCKING: NASA IDSS (ANDROGYNOUS) COMPLIANT, ACTIVE CAPTURE.
12. CARGO BAY: FULL DIAMETER, CLAMSHELL DOORS (4m x 4m), PAYLOAD ACCOM. PER ICD.
13. SECTION A-A SHOWS PORT SIDE REMOVED. STARBOARD INTERNAL SYSTEMS VISIBLE.
